GenAiFunction.description: Updates MEDDPICC qualification fields on an opportunity for deal review. Pass opportunityId and updatesJson with field updates. Format: {"metrics": {"text": "content", "score": 4}, "champion": {"text": "content", "score": 3}}. Dimension keys: metrics, economic_buyer, decision_criteria, decision_process, paper_process, identify_pain, champion, competition. Scores are 1-5 (Very Weak to Very Strong). Returns updated fields and new overall score.
